data.title: 卡提希娅 · 溪湾里的流浪骑士假日
data.description: 【埃格拉海岸溪湾·午后】卡提希娅穿着浅蓝长裙式泳装坐在溪海交界的石头上，脱下靴子让脚尖碰水，金发长辫落到肩前；她把一枚花冠放在膝上，对镜头露出久违的轻松笑容。
data.location: Egra coastal stream beside the sea
data.action: 溪海交界石头上脱靴试水，把花冠放膝上享受没有旅路的一天
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on river and surf
data.mood: 终于停下脚步的骑士假日
data.promptProse: Cartethyia sits on a rock where the Egla stream meets the sea, letting her bare toes touch the water after removing her boots. Her pale-blue long-skirt swimsuit and cream cardigan remain clear, golden braid forward and a flower crown resting on her knees. The horizontal medium view follows fresh water into the surf beyond. Afternoon sunlight catches the braid and current edges, with gentle water reflections on the shaded rock and lowered feet.
